class.name: JRPGPlayer
class.brief_description: The player's character on the current map, with the camera that follows it.
class.description: The [JRPGSceneManager] places one player on the current map and moves it once per simulation step: the [JRPGMover] returned by [method get_mover] decides each step from the map's cell cache, and the node is drawn where the mover says, between the map's lower tiles and its overhead tiles. The player moves with the [code]jrpg_up[/code], [code]jrpg_down[/code], [code]jrpg_left[/code] and [code]jrpg_right[/code] actions; when several are held, the one pressed last wins. Holding [code]jrpg_dash[/code] makes it one speed level faster, unless the map turns dashing off. The [Camera2D] returned by [method get_camera] follows it within the map's bounds. It shows the party leader's character as a [JRPGCharacterSprite] ([method set_character]); without one it draws a marker that shows the way it faces.

method.name: get_camera
method.description: Returns the camera that follows the player.

method.name: get_cell
method.description: Returns the cell the player stands on, or is stepping to.

method.name: get_cell_size
method.description: Returns the size of the map's cells, in pixels.

method.name: get_character
method.description: Returns the character sheet reference the player is drawn with, or an empty string.

method.name: get_direction
method.description: Returns the way the player faces.

method.name: get_mover
method.description: Returns the mover that holds the player's cell, facing, speed and the step under way.

method.name: get_sprite
method.description: Returns the sprite that draws the player's character.

method.name: is_moving
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the player is stepping to the next cell.

method.name: place
method.description: Places the player on [param cell] facing [param direction] at once, ending any step under way.

method.name: set_cell_size
method.description: Sets the size of the map's cells, in pixels, and moves the player to match.

method.name: set_character
method.description: Draws the player with the character sheet [param reference] (a [code]uid://[/code] or [code]res://[/code] path, as an actor's character). An empty reference, or one that cannot be shown, draws the marker.
